review: M12F F0 independent specification and source review

authorized_execution.purpose: One source-bound engineering pass to verify the initial TimingSkill against unchanged archived E1 development behavior.
authorized_execution.same_input_scope: The archived E1 development public-candidate authority receipts for seeds 33000 and 33001.

conditions_before_execution: A successful full real Torch gate for this exact v3 source root, at least 329 tests including the 12 registered F tests, with zero failures, errors or skips and matching test-source hashes.
An immutable runtime identity binding the reviewed study, cases, source manifest, archive, review, gate, actual model manifests and all frozen actor/CVAE files.
The actual held Slurm script and source/run-root arguments must match the reviewed launch; retain the exclusive launch claim and never reuse or overwrite the output root.

Charge every attempted episode and all allocations, including failures. This approval permits one at-most-20-case pass; it does not authorize an automatic retry. Any separately reviewed engineering correction remains within the study-wide maximum of three passes and 60 engineering episodes.
resolved_findings: CLI source-root, study/case hash, exactly-20 unique case IDs and the actual actor manifest are checked before parity execution.
The review must bind study, cases and source-manifest hashes; imported source/test files must match the reviewed archive.
TimingSkill sees hard-legal extra candidates directly. The original E1 heuristic is represented by the initial skill rather than an immutable prefilter.
Original qualification, cooldown, one-CHECK, full-return, effective-measurement and initial/terminal-revisit execution and independent audits remain in use.
Actual completed records and parity-difference receipts are preserved before a gold-equivalence assertion can stop the pass.
Action identity excludes runtime timings, and an unobserved ungated actor counterfactual is reported as null rather than agreement.
remaining_scope: The F1/F2 study is not approved for execution by this review. Its implemented prompt, treatment, selection, numerical tie handling, cache, budget and stage-opening controls require a later integrated immutable-source review.
